info.name: MetaMap Authentication GovChecks API
info.description:
MetaMap (formerly Mati) identity verification REST API. Start and manage user verifications, retrieve verification media, run watchlist, email, phone, credit, court-record, and government database checks across Latin America, Africa, and Asia.

Contact Support:
 Name: MetaMap
